title: Strategic Quality Management
overview: This course offers a comprehensive blend of strategy and quality, equipping participants with the skills needed to design and implement strategic quality plans for their organizations. Participants will explore the evolution of quality and strategy, gaining practical insights into their integration. The course guides participants through analyzing their organization's current state, identifying gaps, and forecasting future needs. It also delves into the strategic planning process, from initiation to selecting initiatives, and discusses the identification of quality key result areas. By the end of the course, participants will have the knowledge, tools, and confidence to create strategic quality plans and deployment frameworks for their departments.
audience: This course is designed for quality managers and professionals involved in shaping, supporting, or implementing long-term quality strategies. It is also ideal for individuals responsible for improving and measuring the performance of quality initiatives or those targeted for development or promotion within the quality function.
methodology: The course employs workshops, case studies, and group discussions to facilitate a deeper understanding of strategic quality concepts and applications. Participants will engage in hands-on exercises to practice strategic planning, draft quality plans, and explore real-world applications through video demonstrations. Team presentations and collaborative activities will further reinforce their grasp of strategic planning and quality deployment processes.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Define the core concepts of quality and strategy, highlighting the main elements of strategic planning in quality.
Analyze the current organizational environment to identify opportunities for drafting a strategic quality plan.
Develop strategic goals for their quality departments.
Translate strategic plans into actionable operational plans.
Measure the success of quality strategies, derive Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), and create a balanced scorecard for the quality department.
